finalTarget: Kirim permintaan untuk {count} film yang melibatkan {person}. Permintaan yang sudah ada dan film yang masuk daftar blokir akan dilewati. Izin dan kuota permintaan yang berlaku tetap diterapkan.
primaryTarget: Kirim permintaan untuk {count} film yang dibintangi {person}. Permintaan yang sudah ada dan film yang masuk daftar blokir akan dilewati. Izin dan kuota permintaan yang berlaku tetap diterapkan.
reason: The caller gathers cast and crew credits, so “dibintangi” (“starring”) narrows the source “by {person}” to actors. “Melibatkan {person}” covers all credited involvement.

finalTarget: Tidak dapat mengajukan permintaan untuk film yang melibatkan orang ini.
primaryTarget: Tidak dapat mengajukan permintaan untuk film yang dibintangi orang ini.
reason: “Dibintangi orang ini” limits the request to movies starring the person, while the caller’s filmography includes all credit types. “Film yang melibatkan orang ini” preserves the broader scope.

finalTarget: Berhasil mengirim {created} permintaan film. {skipped} dilewati; {failed} gagal.
reason: The proposal begins with “Mengirim” (sending) instead of a completed submission. “Berhasil mengirim” makes the success result clear and keeps all three counts.

finalTarget: Ajukan permintaan untuk semua film yang melibatkan {person}
primaryTarget: Ajukan permintaan untuk semua film yang dibintangi {person}
reason: “Dibintangi {person}” again limits the page action to acting credits; the caller uses all cast and crew filmography entries. “Yang melibatkan {person}” keeps the intended wider scope.

currentTarget: Đưa phương tiện vào danh sách chặn.
finalTarget: Đưa nội dung vào danh sách chặn.
reason: “Phương tiện” usually means a vehicle or means of transport. In this media-permissions UI, “nội dung” is the established generic media term and avoids that misreading.

currentTarget: Cho phép đưa phương tiện vào danh sách chặn.
finalTarget: Cho phép đưa nội dung vào danh sách chặn.
reason: Same terminology issue as the permission label: use the app’s established “nội dung” for media, not “phương tiện”.

finalTarget: Xem nội dung trong danh sách chặn.
reason: “Phương tiện bị chặn” can read as a blocked vehicle/device. “Nội dung trong danh sách chặn” clearly means blocklisted media.

currentTarget: Cho phép xem yêu cầu phương tiện được gửi bởi người dùng khác.
finalTarget: Cho phép xem các yêu cầu nội dung do người dùng khác gửi.
reason: Use “yêu cầu nội dung” for media requests and the natural order “do người dùng khác gửi”.
“Phi hành đoàn” means an aircraft crew. In PersonDetails this is the film/TV credits section for crew jobs; “Đoàn làm phim” is the intended film-crew label.
